faqs.question: Which type of AI video tool do I need?
faqs.answer: Choose by workflow first. Generative video tools create or transform footage; avatar-video tools turn scripts into presenter-style videos; screen-recording platforms capture walkthroughs. These categories overlap only partly.

faqs.question: How much do AI video tools cost?
faqs.answer: Current prices and plan limits are not independently verified here. Check official pricing and calculate expected creators, credits or minutes, storage, exports, and collaboration seats.

faqs.question: What should I test before buying?
faqs.answer: Use the same brief and source assets to evaluate output quality, editing effort, consistency, export options, rights, and usage limits.
